source_limits.detail: All13 cited uploads have inspected public previews; full streams returned403. Twelve short preview sequences and38YT01 sheets/342cells were inspected. YT01 sampling is approximately9.956seconds and its gameplay viewport is about112x180pixels. Absence of brief unseen appearances and full motions is not certified.

The November19 reference note lists dock/food catalog thumbnails without direct video IDs. Catalog access returned403. No enemy subject or motion is inferred from these unseen records; they remain a discovery limit rather than an invented roster entry.

18605.png explicitly labels PET COMPANIONS and UNIT TYPES. Companion species/levels, workers and soldiers are not automatically hostile. Fish/resources, hired axe workers and thawed HELP survivors remain correctly classified.
New labels are descriptive working render names. Unknown species/ranks, masked versus anatomical faces, reverse anatomy and exact gear remain qualified per subject.

Independent critic inspected the actual public preview timeline and poster. A hostile red assault crowd is visible, but the small overhead figures do not establish whether it matches the S08 hooded family, red rifle infantry or a distinct appearance. No distinct tenth archetype is proven and no silent mapping is made. Full video stream remains unavailable. This is outside the bounded approval of the nine identified subjects and blocks an unqualified all-reference-enemies completeness claim.
